title: Correct but Unselectable: The Hidden Interface Tax in Multi-Candidate Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models deployed under cost, latency, or privacy constraints cannot simply switch to larger models when reasoning fails. Multi-candidate generate-then-rerank offers a natural test-time scaling route. However, more candidates do not always yield higher accuracy. We identify a previously overlooked bottleneck between generation and selection: a correct answer may appear in the candidate pool yet fail to be selected because it is incomplete, unparseable, or misaligned with the answer mode the fixed selector expects. We term this loss the hidden interface tax and formalize a coverage-conversion decomposition that distinguishes raw oracle coverage from selectable coverage, the subset of problems where a correct candidate can actually be consumed by the selector. translated_title: 正确却无法被选中：多候选推理中的隐性接口税
translated_abstract: 在成本、延迟或隐私约束下部署的小型语言模型，在推理失败时无法简单地切换到更大的模型。多候选“生成后重排”提供了一条自然的测试时扩展路径。然而，更多的候选并不总能带来更高的准确率。我们识别出一个此前被忽视的、介于生成与选择之间的瓶颈：一个正确的答案可能已经出现在候选池中，却因为不完整、无法解析、或与固定选择器所期望的答案格式不对齐而无法被选中。我们将这种损失称为“隐性接口税”，并形式化了“覆盖-转化”分解方法，将原始的神谕覆盖与可选覆盖区分开来——后者是指正确候选实际能够被选择器所消费的问题子集。我们提出兼容性感知的候选构建方法，作为候选源与固定选择器之间的接口层，用于修复片段、对齐答案……
tldr: 该论文发现了多候选推理中被忽视的“隐性接口税”瓶颈——正确答案虽在候选池中却因不完整、不可解析或格式不对齐而无法被选择器选中，并提出兼容性感知候选构建方法（CACC）作为候选源与固定选择器之间的接口层来解决这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "hidden interface tax" in multi-candidate reasoning—where correct answers present in the candidate pool fail to be selected due to incompleteness, unparseability, or format misalignment—and proposes Compatibility-Aware Candidate Construction (CACC) as an interface layer between the candidate source and the fixed selector to address this issue.
